name: GlyphPort
tagline: Port Nothing® Glyph Compositions between phones
blurb: GlyphPort allows you to port Glyph Compositions from one Nothing® phone to another via a simple, easy to use interface.
description:
GlyphPort allows you to port Glyph Compositions from one Nothing® phone to another via a simple, easy to use interface. Whether you're switching to a new Nothing® phone or want to share your unique creations with friends, GlyphPort has got you covered.

All of this is done completely offline on your device and the app is completely free and open source.

install.label: F-Droid
install.note: Adds F-Droid as an update source, so you keep getting updates.
